professionalSummary: Experienced product manager with a proven track record of owning the receipt‑scanning roadmap at Tallyline, leading discovery, usability testing, and analytics for small‑business expense capture.
Demonstrated ability to write detailed product requirements and user stories with acceptance criteria, collaborate with design and engineering in two‑week sprints, and drive launch decisions.
Strong analytical skills, having built and maintained a feature‑adoption dashboard in Amplitude to monitor weekly active scanners and upload completion rates.
experienceHighlights: Owned the receipt‑scanning roadmap and called every launch on it (CPO acknowledgment, src_0164c3ef79ac).
Supported the group product manager for receipt scanning and expense capture in a squad of one designer and five engineers (src_e103279cf929).
Authored user stories and acceptance criteria for receipt‑scanning features and refined them with design and engineering leads before each two‑week sprint (src_9796340b3152).
Ran twelve usability sessions with small‑business bookkeepers on the receipt‑upload flow and summarized findings for quarterly roadmap review (src_8848aa4b1823).
Built a feature‑adoption dashboard in Amplitude tracking weekly active scanners and upload completion rate, shared weekly with the squad (src_0dad8abba4ad).
projectsAndWorkSamples: Product requirements document for multi‑receipt upload, author: candidate, approver: group product manager, acceptance criteria agreed with engineering (src_881bb06c172b).
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume, work sample, and reference check confirm the candidate’s ownership of the receipt‑scanning roadmap, requirement writing, sprint collaboration, usability testing, and analytics tracking. The materials do not establish experience beyond the receipt‑scanning domain or in other product areas.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review required to assess fit for the Product Manager, Expense Management role.

evidence.text: Wrote user stories and acceptance criteria for the receipt‑scanning features and refined them with the design and engineering leads before each two‑week sprint.
Ran twelve usability sessions with small‑business bookkeepers on the receipt‑upload flow and summarized the findings for the group product manager's quarterly roadmap review.
At the 2023 company all‑hands at Tallyline, the chief product officer thanked the candidate as 'the person who owned the receipt‑scanning roadmap' and said the candidate 'called every launch on it'.

The former group product manager confirmed in writing that the candidate worked on receipt scanning as associate product manager from 2022 to 2024 and ran the usability programme, and that roadmap priorities and launch approvals for the area sat with the group product manager.
Wrote user stories and acceptance criteria for the receipt‑scanning features and refined them with the design and engineering leads before each two‑week sprint.
Built the feature‑adoption dashboard in Amplitude, tracking weekly active scanners and the completion rate of the upload flow, and shared it with the squad each week.
